newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Van Miert, Ciampi to meet on Stet.
newsitem.headline: Van Miert, Ciampi to meet on Stet.

text.p: Italian Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi and European Competition Commissioner Karel Van Miert will meet on Monday following the vote by Italy's lower house of parliament against transferring telecommunications giant Stet to the Treasury, Van Miert's spokesman said on Thursday.
Van Miert would not comment on the vote itself, the spokesman said while noting that the decision did not seem "irreparable".
The transfer would allow the Italian government to reduce the debt of state holdings giant IRI, which currently controls Stet, in accordance with a 1993 European Union deal.
The spokesman said the meeting was requested by Ciampi. -- Brussels newsroom 322 2876841
